globe_title: Globe Gallery — Interactive 3D Photo & Travel Memory Website
globe_description: A personal web development project combining photography, location tagging, and interactive 3D visualization. Capture or upload photos and turn travel memories into explorable markers on a globe.
globe_overview: Globe Gallery connects a searchable photo gallery with an interactive 3D globe. Each memory brings together a photo, caption, date, place name, and geographic coordinates, making personal experiences easy to revisit through either images or locations.
globe_goal: The project demonstrates browser API integration, structured local data management, and an interactive interface that connects visual content with geographic context.
globe_feature_globe: Interactive 3D globe: explore geographic markers and select a location to revisit its associated memories.
globe_feature_gallery: Searchable photo gallery: browse dated memories and find photos using captions and place names.
globe_feature_camera: Camera capture and uploads: take photos with a countdown and front/rear camera switching, or import existing images.
globe_feature_gps: GPS tagging: attach the current location through the Geolocation API or enter place names and coordinates manually.
globe_feature_storage: Data storage: Supabase provides the project database, with IndexedDB supporting local photo storage in the browser.
globe_feature_backup: Backup management: export and import complete JSON backups, and download individual photos.
globe_technical_frontend: Frontend: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript provide a responsive interface for capturing, organizing, and exploring memories on desktop and mobile.
globe_technical_visualization: Visualization: a WebGL-based 3D globe library connects latitude and longitude coordinates to interactive memory markers.
globe_technical_storage: Data management: Supabase serves as the database for project data, while IndexedDB supports browser-local photo storage. JSON export/import provides backup management.
globe_technical_apis: Browser integration: camera access and the Geolocation API support photo capture and optional GPS detection. These features require user permission and HTTPS or localhost.
globe_technical_scope: Connectivity: Supabase database access and the CDN-hosted globe library and Earth texture require an internet connection.
globe_demo_description: A walkthrough of photo capture, location tagging, globe exploration, gallery search, and backup management.
globe_demo_pending: Demo video coming soon. Explore the source code on GitHub in the meantime.
